goal: Add GitHub-hosted macOS native CI smoke.
description: Keep local-ci-gate running a macos-latest native CMake configure, build, and CTest smoke so macOS regressions are visible in GitHub Actions.

acceptance_criteria.text: local-ci-gate has a macos-latest job that configures, builds, and runs native tests with CMake.
Docs state that macOS CI is a platform adaptation lane.

goal: Complete macOS native install and release behavior.
description: Validate the Unix installer path on macOS, managed styio installation, release-root lookup, executable permissions, archive layout, codesigning or notarization policy, and quarantine handling for CLI artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.text: macOS installer smoke installs spio and the managed styio launcher into a user-controlled install directory without requiring Linux package manager assumptions.
macOS release docs state the CLI artifact format, checksum policy, signing/notarization stance, and quarantine handling.
macOS CMake and CTest runs pass on the supported architecture before release evidence is recorded.

commit.target: scripts/install-spio.sh, release docs, tests, and macOS evidence

description: Run build, native tests, installer, spio doctor, managed styio install, and clean project workflow smoke on the supported macOS target, then record evidence using the platform template.

acceptance_criteria.text: A macOS machine records build, test, install, doctor, managed styio, and workflow smoke evidence.
The recorded macOS evidence includes architecture, Xcode or command-line tools version, CMake version, and installed artifact paths.

goal: Close macOS artifact and release evidence.
description: Publish or verify macOS spio and managed styio artifacts, including channel pointers, SHA-256 sidecars, doctor evidence, installer smoke evidence, and any required signing or quarantine notes.

acceptance_criteria.text: darwin-aarch64 has release artifacts or is explicitly excluded from public support claims.
macOS release evidence uses the shared platform evidence template and records artifact URLs, checksums, signing stance, quarantine stance, and installed paths.

commit.target: macOS release docs, package roots, and evidence records
